title: MechanicsResult
description: The probe's answer to one MechanicsQuery (ADR-016 section 2), tagged by kind: computed (the engine's own values), unsupported (the query is outside the mechanics config's scope or the probe cannot answer it exactly: a closed reason and a position) or refused (a set the engine does not accept: a closed code and the set's position). No field holds free text from the input; the validator's messages go to the caller's stderr, never into a result. The result's data_class equals the query's. Integers only. The same showdown_commit, format_rules_hash, mechanics_config_hash, adapter_format and query give byte-identical results (repeatability class exact). A query that fails the MechanicsQuery schema has no result.

VersionManifest.description: Replay identity of a battle (ADR-003, ADR-007): the pinned engine commit, the format, and the hashes of the engine ruleset and of Areneon's own format rules.

ruleset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical engine ruleset.

format_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of Areneon's format rules record (ADR-007).

query_hash.description: SHA-256 of the query's JCS bytes.

mechanics_config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the mechanics config the probe used.

adapter_format.description: A constant of the probe, bumped when it changes how it reads a value from the engine (as ENCODER_FORMAT is for the encoder).

gap_ids.description: The gap ledger rows the result depends on, sorted and unique (reader rule).

answer.description: The engine's values, tagged by the query kind.

Unsupported.description: The query is outside what the probe answers exactly; nothing is approximated.

query_hash.description: SHA-256 of the query's JCS bytes.

mechanics_config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the mechanics config the probe used.

adapter_format.description: A constant of the probe, bumped when it changes how it reads a value from the engine (as ENCODER_FORMAT is for the encoder).

gap_ids.description: The gap ledger rows the result depends on, sorted and unique (reader rule).

reason.description: query_kind: the kind is not in the mechanics config's scope. scenario_rule_table: the engine's rule tables differ from the config's scenario. random_effect: the engine drew a random number the probe does not expect.

position.description: The index of the set, action or Pokemon the reason names; null when it names the query as a whole.

Refused.description: A set the engine does not accept.

query_hash.description: SHA-256 of the query's JCS bytes.

mechanics_config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the mechanics config the probe used.

adapter_format.description: A constant of the probe, bumped when it changes how it reads a value from the engine (as ENCODER_FORMAT is for the encoder).

gap_ids.description: The gap ledger rows the result depends on, sorted and unique (reader rule).

code.description: invalid_set: the set is not the engine's canonical PokePaste of one Pokemon, or the pinned validator refuses it in the format.

position.description: The index of the refused set in the query (stats: 0; speed_order: the sides' Pokemon in order; damage: attacker 0, defender 1).

StatsAnswer.description: The six stats at the format's level.

Stats.description: The engine's own values: maximum HP and the five stats.

SpeedOrderAnswer.description: The turn order of the declared actions.

order_basis.description: turn_start: the order at the start of the turn; speed changes during the turn are not modelled.

actions.description: The query's actions, in query order. order, priority and speed are the action's own keys (a switch or a move) read after every Mega Evolution of the turn has run, so a Mega's new Speed counts; the Evolution's own order is only its place in groups.

groups.description: Tie groups in execution order: each lists the indices into actions of the actions the engine orders exactly equally (their order among themselves is a draw and is never sampled). A Mega Evolution is its own group, before any move (and after any switch), so up to four move or switch groups and four Evolution groups.

ActionOrder.description: One action's keys in the engine's ordering.

order.description: The engine's action order value (lower acts first).

speed.description: The action speed the engine computes: the Speed stat after boosts and modifiers, or its negative under Trick Room (the champions mod negates it, with no wrap).

DamageAnswer.description: Two 16-roll damage vectors, the crit chance, the defender's HP and the KO counts.

Rolls.description: Damage for each random roll 0 to 15, as the engine's getDamage returns it: before the HP clamp and before damage-time effects.

CritChance.description: always: the move always crits. never: the engine makes no crit draw or cancels the crit. chance: the engine's one randomChance call, exactly as passed.

KoCounts.description: counts: integers, never combined into a probability. unsupported: the defender holds an item or ability on the config's ko_blockers list, so no count is given.

ohko_no_crit.description: Rolls of 16 whose damage is at least the defender's current HP.

thko_no_crit.description: Ordered pairs of two independent rolls (of 256) whose sum is at least that HP, no crit on either hit and the same damage vector for both.
